data.description:
Held capture from the 2026-08-10 launch-polish grill — the deliberate deferral from the 2026-08-07 strategy grill ("capture when launch nears") now cashed in: launch is near, the three build tasks (toolchain, identity, docs pass) are the remaining wall.

Content is undecided on purpose and gets its own Brandon-led grill: which channels (Show HN, X, elsewhere), what the announcement actually says, and timing relative to the three builds landing. Held: agents must not claim this; it becomes ready only after Brandon grills it.
data.title: The announcement moment: where, what, when
